title: SAML 2.0 declarative connector setup with schema-aware metadata diffing and replayable validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Replace the current interactive SAML onboarding form with a declarative connector setup that performs schema-aware diffs between incoming IdP metadata and Redwood's canonical SAML schema, produces human-readable change sets for admins, and runs a replayable validation pipeline that can be re-run after fixes. The flow must integrate with RBAC v2 checks and emit structured audit events for every metadata change and validation attempt.
background: We have recurring support cases where IdP metadata updates (cert rotation, endpoint renames) break sign-in in non-obvious ways. Current validation is permissive and only surface-level, causing long-lived misconfigurations. This ticket implements a stricter, explainable verification step that surfaces probable root causes and provides operators a guided remediation path without blocking private deployments that require manual approval.
acceptance_criteria: Admin UI shows a schema-aware diff between current connector config and uploaded IdP metadata with color-coded severity (info/warning/error)

System produces a replayable validation record (validation-id) for each upload that includes XML parse errors, fingerprint mismatches, signing cert validity, entityID similarity score, and endpoint TLS checks
RBAC v2: only users with 'saml.manage' scope can apply metadata changes; UI hides auto-apply unless user has 'saml.apply' permission
Every metadata upload and validation step emits structured audit events (saml.metadata.upload, saml.metadata.validate, saml.metadata.apply) consumed by our audit pipeline and visible in Console logs
Graceful fallback: if entityID mismatch but similarity score >= 0.8, UI offers 'auto-map with admin confirmation' and logs the decision
End-to-end tests cover SOAP and HTTP-POST SSO bindings and cert rotations (short-lived and multi-cert bundles)
steps: Design schema-aware diff model and severity heuristics (security to review)
Backend: implement MetadataIntrospector service that canonicalizes XML, computes diffs, verifies signatures and cert chains, and produces a compact validation record
Backend: persist validation records (immutable) with validation-id and wire a replay API for re-running checks against new network conditions
RBAC: add 'saml.manage' and 'saml.apply' scopes to RBAC v2 and enforce in gateway and Console endpoints
Frontend: create 'Connector Review' panel showing diffs, confidence scores, recommended remediations, and preview of mapped attributes
Audit: emit structured events to event-bus and redact PII before retention per compliance policy
QA: develop targeted integration tests and a self-service harness for partners to run metadata validation against staging IdPs
Run dogfood with two pilot customers on Dedicated and one Private deployment; collect telemetry and support triage notes
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Overstrict validation may block legitimate IdP changes — mitigation: provide 'apply anyway' toggle gated by permission and require explicit admin acknowledgement
Risk: Metadata parsing differences across vendor idiosyncrasies — mitigation: build extensible vendor heuristics and ship a compatibility-mode flag
Risk: Audit volume spike — mitigation: batch low-fidelity events and use sampling for verbose XML parse traces
Risk: Clock skew causing signature validation failures — mitigation: implement configurable clock-skew tolerance and surface local time checks in validation record
